title: Per-port mode tracking, normalization, reference planes, direction separation and degenerate/weak-mode diagnostics on the analytic slab and a degenerate square guide

fixture.slab: tests/test_ports.py: symmetric slab, core epsilon 4 (interface samples 3.125), cladding 2.25, thickness 0.5 um, transverse grid 80 x 4 cells of 0.05 um, normal z, periodic full-vector solver solve_waveguide_modes, float32, CPU; tracked at 1.45, 1.5, 1.55, 1.6, 1.65 um with num_modes 2 and 4 candidates
fixture.square_guide: tests/test_ports.py: 0.6 um square core of epsilon 4 in 2.25, 16 x 16 cells of 0.1 um, 1.55 um, two modes (the degenerate fundamental pair)
fixture.weak_guide: tests/test_ports.py: 0.1 um core of epsilon 2.3 in 2.25, 40 x 4 cells of 0.1 um, normal z, 1.55 um, one mode; declared core |u| < 0.05 um
fixture.uniform_section: tests/test_ports.py: epsilon 2.25, 5 x 5 cells of 0.2 um (reference-plane and de-embedding checks) and 8 x 6 cells of 0.1 um (direction separation on synthetic plane fields)
fixture.network_rejection: tests/test_ports.py: ModeNetwork on the 8 x 1 x 1 um, 0.2 um straight-guide fixture of tests/test_mode_network.py with a section tensor that requires grad

seed.others: deterministic; the eigensolver uses its fixed start vector

reference_method: Analytic continuum slab TE0/TM0 dispersion at every tracked wavelength (root finding, tests/test_mode_ports.py slab_neff); the analytic identities exp(i beta d) exp(-i beta d) = 1 and S21 = exp(2 i beta L) of a straight guide de-embedded to the identity; synthetic plane fields a * mode + b * backward whose separated amplitudes must equal a and b with analytic gradients 2a and 2b; the canonical degenerate basis of the same discrete operator.

observables.name: tracked_neff_error
observables.definition: |neff_track - neff_analytic| for TE0 and TM0 at each of the five wavelengths

observables.name: minimum_overlap
observables.definition: smallest absolute power overlap between consecutive wavelengths of one track

observables.name: degenerate_cluster
observables.definition: cluster tuple of the square guide's fundamental pair and the max deviation of its overlap matrix from the identity

observables.name: confinement
observables.definition: fraction of the summed squared six-component amplitude inside the declared core

observables.name: separated_amplitudes
observables.definition: |a+/scale - a|, |a-/scale - b| and the gradient error of |a+|^2 + |a-|^2 against 2a, 2b

observables.name: fixed_section_rejection
observables.definition: FixedPortSectionError raised by track_port_modes, fixed_port_section and ModeNetwork for a section with requires_grad

tracked_neff_error_max.where: tests/test_ports.py; the 0.05 um slab at 1.45 to 1.65 um; mode_ports.md records 7.9e-4 (TE) and 1.6e-3 (TM) at 1.55 um on this mesh
tracked_neff_error_max.difference_from_common_criterion: absolute 2e-3 at neff about 1.75 is relative 1.1e-3, inside the program's analytic_mode_neff_relative_error 0.005

acceptance.tracking_warning: ModeTrackingWarning must be issued when the declared minimum exceeds the measured overlap (declared 0.99999 on the 1.55 to 1.6 um pair)

confinement.warning: WeakModeWarning for the weak guide, none for the slab

acceptance.source_of_limits: completion_gates.json proposed_thresholds analytic_mode_neff_relative_error 0.005 for the tracked indices; the remaining limits are identities of the fixed-basis algebra at float32 precision

tests/test_ports.py::test_slab_tracking_.oracle: analytic slab TE0/TM0 dispersion at five wavelengths

reference-plane shift applied to a measured FDTD network rather than the analytic straight-guide S

open (CPML) port modes are not tracked by this module

error_budget.precision_floor: float32 eigenvectors: overlap identities within 2e-4; complex64 synthetic amplitudes within 2e-5 relative
error_budget.time_window: not applicable (frequency-domain eigenproblem and algebraic identities)

notes: tests/test_ports.py is added with this case. The gradient statement of the task (fixed-basis gradients only, no eigenmode derivative, a trainable section rejected by name) is documented in docs/PORTS.md and enforced by fixed_port_section, which ModeNetwork and ModeBranchNetwork now call. The slab confinement limit of 0.7 follows the measured 0.762 of the 0.5 um slab core at 1.55 um on this mesh, observed before the recorded run.
